summary_en: Provides a standardized protocol for producing plain and functionalized lipid-shelled nanobubbles for contrast-enhanced ultrasound imaging and therapy. The workflow covers formulation, activation, purification, quality control, size and concentration measurements, buoyancy, echogenicity, acoustic performance, and common failure modes affecting reproducibility.
